messages.subject: 請教各位有關超幾何分配抽樣問題
parts:
想請教各位
為何會出現初始值有問題
感覺N跟pd我都已經設定為正整數了
以下是我的原始碼

rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))
library(AcceptanceSampling)
plans=matrix(nrow = 40000, ncol = 5)
colnames(plans)=c("Iteration", "Lot piece", "Sample size", "Accept size", "Detective size")
Time=(Sys.time())
for(i in 1:40000)
{
  for(N in seq(1000,10000,100))
  {
    for (n in 100:200)
    {
      for (c in 0:5)
      {
        for (r in c:c+1)
        {
          oc=OC2c(n,c,r,type = "h",N,pd=0.01)
          sp=assess(oc, PRP = c(0.02, 0.95), CRP = c(0.1, 0.1))
          plans[i, ]=cbind(i,N,n,c,r,sp)
          print(plans[i, ])
          ##write.table(plans,'D:/for.txt',sep=',',row.names = T, append = F)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
write.table(plans,'D:/for.txt',sep=',',row.names = T, append = F)
Sys.time()-Time

messages.subject: Re: 請教各位有關超幾何分配抽樣問題
parts:
Hi 明祥,

參考以內容:

1. 修正 N=N 即不會有該錯誤.
oc <- OC2c(n,c,r,type = "h", N=N, pd=0.01)

2. sp <- assess(oc, PRP = c(0.02, 0.95), CRP = c(0.1, 0.1), print=FALSE) 

(a). 計算結果sp 為list, 有7個元素
(b). list 資料不可直接使用 cbind(i,N,n,c,r,sp)
(c). 使用以下指令取出值: sp$屬性名稱 , 本範例示範使用  sp$c, 請依需求修改
(d). 加入 print=FALSE 可省略列印結果, 以加速程式進行.
(e). 部份參數以修改為較小數值, 以利測試.



library(AcceptanceSampling)

plans <- matrix(nrow = 40000, ncol = 5)
colnames(plans) <- c("Iteration", "Lot piece", "Sample size", "Accept size", "Detective size")

(Time <- Sys.time())

for(i in 1:5) {
  
  for(N in seq(1000, 5000, 1000)) {

for (n in 100:200) {
      
      for (c in 0:5) {
        
        for (r in c:c+1) {

oc <- OC2c(n,c,r,type = "h",N=N,pd=0.01)
          sp <- assess(oc, PRP = c(0.02, 0.95), CRP = c(0.1, 0.1), print=FALSE)
          print(paste0("i=", i, " N=", N, " n=", n, " c=", c, " r=", r))
          plans[i, ] <- c(i, N, n, c, sp$c)
          
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

write.table(plans,'D:/for.txt', sep=',', row.names=FALSE, append=FALSE)
Sys.time() - Time
# end
